searchText: Okay cool, it's finally been added. Took longer than I would have expected on a devnet. To be exact, it was 5 hours and 58 minutes. <@412614104222531604> how long is devnet 7 expected to stay up? until devnet-8 launch We will require mostly green hive tests before we spin up devnet 8. So this might still be about 1.5-2 weeks away. Depends on the client teams. do we have any tests (EVM or hive) for 4788? 🙂 Perhaps, <@892053833121923094> will know 🙂 I'm working on the EVM tests for these right now! Should have the fixtures ready by next week They will be added to the hive pyspec simulator as well 😄
